_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "empresas" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "razon_social" TEXT NOT NULL, "cif" TEXT NULL, "n_habilitacion_rite" TEXT NULL, "ccaa" TEXT NULL, "n_certificado_fgas_empresa" TEXT NULL, "logo_ruta" TEXT NULL, "es_demo" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("es_demo" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "miembros" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "rol" TEXT NOT NULL, "nombre" TEXT NOT NULL, "carne_rite" TEXT NULL, "cert_fgas_tipo" TEXT NULL, "cert_fgas_numero" TEXT NULL, "cert_fgas_caduca" TEXT NULL, "serie_informes" TEXT NULL, "activo" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("activo" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dispositivos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "miembro_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "letra" TEXT NOT NULL, "registrado_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "ultimo_numero" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "ultima_sync_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "clientes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "razon_social" TEXT NOT NULL, "cif" TEXT NULL, "contacto_nombre" TEXT NULL, "contacto_telefono" TEXT NULL, "contacto_email" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "instalaciones" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "cliente_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nombre" TEXT NOT NULL, "direccion" TEXT NULL, "uso_edificio" TEXT NOT NULL, "expediente_ccaa" TEXT NULL, "potencia_frio_kw" REAL NULL, "potencia_calor_kw" REAL NULL, "fecha_primer_certificado" TEXT NULL, "contrato_mantenimiento" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("contrato_mantenimiento" IN (0, 1)), "manual_disponible" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("manual_disponible" IN (0, 1)), "supervision_remota" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("supervision_remota" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "equipos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "instalacion_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tipo" TEXT NOT NULL, "categoria_fgas" TEXT NULL, "marca" TEXT NULL, "modelo" TEXT NULL, "n_serie" TEXT NULL, "ubicacion" TEXT NULL, "fecha_instalacion" TEXT NULL, "potencia_frio_kw" REAL NULL, "potencia_calor_kw" REAL NULL, "refrigerante" TEXT NULL, "carga_kg" REAL NULL, "hermetico_etiquetado" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("hermetico_etiquetado" IN (0, 1)), "deteccion_fugas" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("deteccion_fugas" IN (0, 1)), "deteccion_ultima_revision" TEXT NULL, "etiqueta_ok" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("etiqueta_ok" IN (0, 1)), "preventivo_previo_declarado" TEXT NULL, "control_fugas_previo_declarado" TEXT NULL, "origen_datos" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "placa_foto_id" TEXT NULL, "datos_confirmados_por" TEXT NULL, "datos_confirmados_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "estado_equipo" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ultimo_preventivo_at" TEXT NULL, "ultima_inspeccion_id" TEXT NULL, "ultimo_control_fugas_at" TEXT NULL, "ultimo_resultado_fugas" TEXT NULL, "ultimos_valores_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "incidencias_abiertas_json" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "plantillas" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NULL, "clave" TEXT NOT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "titulo" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_normativa" TEXT NULL, "aplica_a" TEXT NOT NULL, "estado" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'borrador', "sustituye_a" TEXT NULL, "publicada_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "items_plantilla" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NULL, "plantilla_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "clave" TEXT NOT NULL, "orden" INTEGER NOT NULL, "seccion" TEXT NULL, "codigo_normativo" TEXT NULL, "texto" TEXT NOT NULL, "tipo_respuesta" TEXT NOT NULL, "unidad" TEXT NULL, "rango_min" REAL NULL, "rango_max" REAL NULL, "obligatorio" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("obligatorio" IN (0, 1)), "foto_obligatoria" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("foto_obligatoria" IN (0, 1)), "analizable_ia" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("analizable_ia" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ordenes_trabajo" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "instalacion_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tecnico_id" TEXT NULL, "fecha_prevista" TEXT NULL, "tipo_intervencion" TEXT NOT NULL, "estado" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pendiente', "origen_id" TEXT NULL, "notas_oficina" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "orden_equipos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "orden_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "equipo_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plantilla_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "ordenes_sugeridas" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "equipo_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "control_origen_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tipo" TEXT NOT NULL, "desde" TEXT NOT NULL, "hasta" TEXT NOT NULL, "estado" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pendiente', "orden_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inspecciones" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "orden_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tecnico_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "numero" TEXT NULL, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "rectifica_a" TEXT NULL, "iniciada_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "finalizada_at" TEXT NULL, "firmada_at" TEXT NULL, "sincronizada_at" TEXT NULL, "gps_inicio" TEXT NULL, "gps_firma" TEXT NULL, "resumen_texto" TEXT NULL, "resumen_origen" TEXT NULL, "estado" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en_curso', "n_equipos" INTEGER NULL, "n_respuestas" INTEGER NULL, "n_incidencias" INTEGER NULL, "n_fotos" INTEGER NULL, "n_enlaces_fotos" INTEGER NULL, "n_notas" INTEGER NULL, "n_controles" INTEGER NULL, "n_movimientos_gas" INTEGER NULL, "n_resoluciones" INTEGER NULL, "pdf_ruta" TEXT NULL, "pdf_sha256" TEXT NULL, "contenido_sha256" TEXT NULL, "normativa_version" TEXT NULL, "app_version" TEXT NULL, "datos_cabecera_json" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inspeccion_equipos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspeccion_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "equipo_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "plantilla_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "datos_equipo_json" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "respuestas" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspeccion_equipo_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_plantilla_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "texto_item" TEXT NOT NULL, "codigo_normativo" TEXT NULL, "estado" TEXT NULL, "valor_num" REAL NULL, "unidad" TEXT NULL, "observacion" TEXT NULL, "origen" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "propuesta_ia_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "incidencias" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspeccion_equipo_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "respuesta_id" TEXT NULL, "descripcion" TEXT NOT NULL, "gravedad" TEXT NULL, "accion_recomendada" TEXT NULL, "plazo_dias" INTEGER NULL, "para_equipo" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("para_equipo" IN (0, 1)), "origen" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "propuesta_ia_id" TEXT NULL, "decidida_por" TEXT NULL, "decidida_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "incidencia_fotos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspeccion_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "incidencia_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "foto_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "resoluciones_incidencia" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "incidencia_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspeccion_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspeccion_equipo_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "nota" TEXT NULL, "resuelta_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "controles_fugas" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspeccion_equipo_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "metodo" TEXT NULL, "detector_modelo" TEXT NULL, "detector_calibracion" TEXT NULL, "resultado" TEXT NOT NULL, "localizacion" TEXT NULL, "reparada" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("reparada" IN (0, 1)), "fecha_reparacion" TEXT NULL, "recontrol_desde" TEXT NULL, "recontrol_hasta" TEXT NULL, "control_origen_id" TEXT NULL, "eficaz" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("eficaz" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "movimientos_gas" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspeccion_equipo_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tipo" TEXT NOT NULL, "refrigerante" TEXT NOT NULL, "kg" REAL NOT NULL, "origen_gas" TEXT NULL, "regenerado_lote" TEXT NULL, "regenerado_etiqueta_foto_id" TEXT NULL, "reciclado_recuperado_por" TEXT NULL, "reciclado_declaracion" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("reciclado_declaracion" IN (0, 1)), "gestor_nombre" TEXT NULL, "gestor_documento" TEXT NULL, "motivo" TEXT NULL, "aviso_pcg" INTEGER NULL CHECK ("aviso_pcg" IN (0, 1)), "regla_aplicada" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fotos" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspeccion_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspeccion_equipo_id" TEXT NULL, "item_plantilla_id" TEXT NULL, "proposito" TEXT NOT NULL, "ruta" TEXT NOT NULL, "ruta_miniatura" TEXT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "ancho" INTEGER NULL, "alto" INTEGER NULL, "calidad_local" TEXT NULL, "calidad_nitidez" REAL NULL, "calidad_brillo" REAL NULL, "tomada_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "gps" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notas_voz" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspeccion_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspeccion_equipo_id" TEXT NULL, "ruta" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime" TEXT NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "duracion_s" REAL NULL, "grabada_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "firmas" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspeccion_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rol" TEXT NOT NULL, "nombre" TEXT NOT NULL, "cargo" TEXT NULL, "ruta_png" TEXT NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "firmada_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "gps" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "comparticiones" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspeccion_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "canal" TEXT NOT NULL, "at" TEXT NOT NULL, "por" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "propuestas_ia" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tipo" TEXT NOT NULL, "objetivo_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "entrada_sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "modelo" TEXT NOT NULL, "version_prompt" TEXT NOT NULL, "resultado_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "tokens_entrada" INTEGER NULL, "tokens_salida" INTEGER NULL, "reserva_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "decisiones_ia" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "empresa_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "inspeccion_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "propuesta_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "indice" INTEGER NOT NULL, "decision" TEXT NOT NULL, "valor_final_json" TEXT NULL, "decidida_por" TEXT NOT NULL, "decidida_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "blobs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origen_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "variante" TEXT NOT NULL, "bytes" BLOB NOT NULL, "mime" TEXT NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "bucket" TEXT NULL, "ruta" TEXT NULL, "subido_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "trabajos_ia" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tipo" TEXT NOT NULL, "objetivo_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "estado" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pendiente', "intentos" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "error" TEXT NULL, "propuesta_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "contadores_informe" ("serie" TEXT NOT NULL, "ultimo" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("serie"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox_entries" ("seq" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "is_blocked" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_blocked" IN (0, 1)), "esperando_hijos" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("esperando_hijos" IN (0, 1)));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_cursors" ("entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_pulled_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("entity"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE INDEX dispositivos_miembro ON dispositivos (miembro_id)

CREATE INDEX incidencias_inspeccion_equipo ON incidencias (inspeccion_equipo_id)
CREATE INDEX incidencia_fotos_inspeccion ON incidencia_fotos (inspeccion_id)
CREATE INDEX incidencia_fotos_incidencia ON incidencia_fotos (incidencia_id)
CREATE INDEX resoluciones_incidencia_inspeccion ON resoluciones_incidencia (inspeccion_id)
CREATE INDEX resoluciones_incidencia_incidencia ON resoluciones_incidencia (incidencia_id)
CREATE INDEX controles_fugas_inspeccion_equipo ON controles_fugas (inspeccion_equipo_id)
CREATE INDEX controles_fugas_origen ON controles_fugas (control_origen_id)
CREATE INDEX movimientos_gas_inspeccion_equipo ON movimientos_gas (inspeccion_equipo_id)
CREATE INDEX fotos_inspeccion ON fotos (inspeccion_id)
CREATE INDEX fotos_inspeccion_equipo ON fotos (inspeccion_equipo_id)
CREATE INDEX notas_voz_inspeccion ON notas_voz (inspeccion_id)
CREATE INDEX firmas_inspeccion ON firmas (inspeccion_id)
CREATE INDEX comparticiones_inspeccion ON comparticiones (inspeccion_id)
CREATE INDEX propuestas_ia_objetivo ON propuestas_ia (objetivo_id)
CREATE INDEX decisiones_ia_propuesta ON decisiones_ia (propuesta_id)
CREATE INDEX decisiones_ia_inspeccion ON decisiones_ia (inspeccion_id)
CREATE INDEX blobs_origen ON blobs (origen_id)
CREATE INDEX trabajos_ia_estado ON trabajos_ia (estado)
CREATE INDEX trabajos_ia_objetivo ON trabajos_ia (objetivo_id)
